verdict.rationale: The core runtime (RDK) has a public GitHub repository at viamrobotics/rdk, and the README shows running the server from source (`go run ./web/cmd/server`). That shows the source is readable, but nothing in the pack names its license or confirms it is open. A community member was also unsure how much of Viam is open source; that is an open question, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license for the RDK, clarity on which parts (cloud app, registry, fleet services) are open versus proprietary, and independent corroboration of the licensing.
